supplier_legal_name.description: Legal name of the SELLER who issued the invoice (usually at the top, not the Bill To / buyer party). Copy exactly as printed. Empty string if not present.

supplier_gstin.description: 15-character GSTIN of the SELLER who issued the invoice. Not the buyer's GSTIN under Bill To. Copy exactly as printed. Empty string if not present.

buyer_gstin.description: GSTIN printed under Bill To / Buyer / Recipient. Copy exactly as printed. Empty string if not present.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number exactly as printed, including any prefix, slashes or dashes. Empty string if not present.

invoice_date.description: Transcribe the invoice date. Use YYYY-MM-DD only when the date is unambiguous. Preserve the printed text if its ordering is ambiguous. Leave empty when absent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amounts, e.g. INR for Rs, Rs., INR or the rupee sign. Empty string if not stated.

line_items.description: Every row of the items table, in printed order. Do not merge, skip or add rows.

items.description: One row of the items table.

hsn.description: HSN or SAC code as printed. Empty string if none.

quantity.description: Quantity as a plain decimal using ASCII digits, without units or commas, e.g. 40 or 2.5. Empty string if not legible.

unit_price.description: Rate per unit as a plain decimal using ASCII digits, without commas or currency symbols, e.g. 1150.00. Empty string if not legible.

amount.description: Line amount as printed, as a plain decimal without commas, e.g. 46000.00. Do not calculate it. Empty string if not legible.

subtotal.description: Taxable value / subtotal before tax as printed, as a plain decimal without commas, e.g. 90000.00. Do not calculate. Empty string if not printed.

cgst_rate.description: CGST rate in percent as printed, as a plain number, e.g. 9. Empty string if the invoice shows no CGST.

cgst.description: CGST amount as printed, as a plain decimal without commas. Do not calculate. Empty string if the invoice shows no CGST.

sgst_rate.description: SGST (or UTGST) rate in percent as printed, as a plain number, e.g. 9. Empty string if the invoice shows no SGST.

sgst.description: SGST (or UTGST) amount as printed, as a plain decimal without commas. Do not calculate. Empty string if the invoice shows no SGST.

igst_rate.description: IGST rate in percent as printed, as a plain number, e.g. 18. Empty string if the invoice shows no IGST.

igst.description: IGST amount as printed, as a plain decimal without commas. Do not calculate. Empty string if the invoice shows no IGST.

tax_total.description: Total tax amount ONLY if printed as its own line, as a plain decimal without commas. Do not add up taxes yourself. Empty string if not printed.

grand_total.description: Final invoice total payable as printed in figures, as a plain decimal without commas, e.g. 106200.00. Do not calculate. Empty string if not legible.

total_in_words.description: The amount in words exactly as printed, in its original language and script. Do not translate, convert or correct it. Empty string if not present.

bank_reference.description: Transcribe a printed opaque ref: or demo: reference only. Leave empty when absent. Never return account numbers or infer a reference.
